notes: GHS-UCDB R2024A V1.2 EXPOSURE + HAZARD_RISK themes (doi:10.2905/1a338be6-7eaf-480c-9664-3a8ade88cbcd); column meanings per GHSL_UCDB_R2024_V1_2.pdf pp.164-185, 294-301, 337-350 — see etl/notes/ghsl-hazard.md.
All metrics are modelled hazard footprints/maps overlaid on GHS-POP R2023A epoch 2025 -> quality=estimated. Hazard maps ignore flood defences and building codes: this is exposure, not risk.
Earthquake columns derive from the GEM Global Seismic Hazard Map 2023.1, licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial, share-alike) — check before commercial use.

Cyclone-wind exposure columns (EX_*_S1P/S3P, STORM) were NOT used: implausible values (shares up to 200 %, zero for Tokyo/Hong Kong/Miami, non-zero for Marrakesh/Caracas). Typhoon exposure uses MYRIAD-HES counts.
